_doc: Drives portfolio-gate's voice memory-loop probe in CI. toolSecretHeader still names the LEGACY header on purpose: the probe runs against PRODUCTION, and production only accepts the canonical x-convai-tool-secret once THIS branch has merged and deployed. Removing the override while the branch was still open made the gate fail — a config change is only valid once the code it depends on is live, which is the same ordering the header migration itself follows (rename in, re-provision, rename out). REMOVE this line in the follow-up commit, after the 13 agents are re-provisioned onto the canonical header and prod is serving the dual-accept route. The option then disappears from Kira entirely; it stays in portfolio-gate for products that genuinely need a different name.
_post_call_doc: postCallPath is ORIGIN-relative on purpose. Kira mounts the conversation TOOLS at /api/kira/webhooks/* but the post-call webhook at /api/convai/webhooks/post-call — a layout that neither a child route ('post-call' under the tool path) nor an absolute URL in a committed file (wrong the moment the gate runs against a preview) can express. Before this key existed the probe derived post-call as a child of the tool path, got a 404, and scored it as 'refused': the check with the most direct security consequence was the one asserting nothing.
